If we exclude those invoices, the eligible receivables balance drops from $8.5 million to exactly $7.2 million. Additionally, the closing file must include a signed assignment-consent package for both the KITE and NORTHSTAR customers before we can proceed. I have not yet uploaded this review to the transaction folder, but I wanted to make sure everyone is aware of this now.
